title: Resolv USR (USR) 📉 -56.7%

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Resolv USR is undervalued because it's the only protocol with cross-chain dispute resolution baked into its core design.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But the market is betting against its recovery, and with no major partnerships, its adoption is stagnant and unlikely to pick up.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You’re ignoring its integration with Layer 2s and its use of zero-knowledge proofs — features that are becoming essential in DeFi.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with that, without a clear roadmap or token utility beyond governance, recovery is just a pipe dream for investors.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This isn’t just a dip — it’s a death knell for Resolv USR’s relevance in the evolving blockchain ecosystem.
